skip_reason: Services offline — backend (localhost:3001) and frontend (localhost:5173) not reachable; both specialists ran static analysis mode only
baseline_note: No usable prior audit baseline — inspector-report.md was empty

backlog.title: Vitest UI Server RCE
backlog.description: Unauthenticated arbitrary file read/execute when Vitest UI server is listening. Any network attacker achieves RCE on developer machines and CI environments.
backlog.fix: cd Source/Frontend && npm install vitest@^3.2.6

backlog.title: Handlebars.js JavaScript Injection (Code Execution)
backlog.description: Multiple JavaScript injection vulnerabilities via AST Type Confusion. Attacker crafts template inputs to execute arbitrary code, pollute prototype, or cause DoS.
backlog.fix: cd Source/Backend && npm ls handlebars (identify chain) && npm install {root-package}@latest

backlog.title: Traceability Enforcer Blind to portal/ — 74 FRs Invisible to Gate
backlog.description: source_dirs = ["Source", "E2E"] never scans portal/. Running the enforcer against Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md reports 76 MISSING even though 74/76 are fully implemented in portal/. Gate produces false alarms and misses real regressions.
backlog.fix: Add "portal" to source_dirs list in tools/traceability-enforcer.py line 75

backlog.title: Vite Path Traversal & FS Bypass
backlog.description: server.fs.deny bypass, path traversal in optimized deps, NTLMv2 hash disclosure. Unauthenticated read access to source, .env files, secrets.
backlog.fix: cd Source/Frontend && npm install vite@latest (major version bump to 8.x — review release notes)

backlog.title: UUID Buffer Overflow (CVSS 7.5)
backlog.description: Missing buffer bounds check in UUID v3/v5/v6 when buf parameter provided. Attacker triggers buffer overflow with undersized buffer → memory corruption, potential RCE.
backlog.fix: cd Source/Backend && npm install uuid@^11.1.1

backlog.title: Form-Data CRLF Injection
backlog.description: Multipart form field names/filenames not escaped → CRLF injection → HTTP response splitting, cache poisoning, session fixation.
backlog.fix: npm update form-data (in both Source/Backend and Source/Frontend)

backlog.title: React Router Open Redirect
backlog.description: Same-origin redirect with // prefix reinterpreted as protocol-relative URL → open redirect → phishing, session hijacking.
backlog.fix: cd Source/Frontend && npm install react-router-dom@^6.30.4

backlog.title: JS-YAML DoS (Quadratic Complexity)
backlog.description: YAML merge-key chains cause quadratic CPU consumption. Specially crafted YAML → exponential-time expansion → service unavailability.
backlog.fix: cd Source/Backend && npm update js-yaml --depth=20

backlog.title: WebSocket Memory Exhaustion DoS
backlog.description: Memory exhaustion from fragmented WebSocket frames → server memory exhaustion → crash/restart.
backlog.fix: npm update ws

backlog.title: Traceability Gate Only Checks One Plan (Highest mtime)
backlog.description: Running the enforcer with no args always selects self-judging-workflow/requirements.md (highest mtime). Five other plans fail when explicitly targeted.
backlog.fix: Update gate to iterate all Plans/*/requirements.md or accept --all flag

backlog.title: FR-dependency-* IDs Don't Match Spec FR-070–085
backlog.description: Plan references FR-070–FR-085 but no code uses those IDs. Enforcer permanently reports FR-070 and FR-085 as MISSING.
backlog.fix: Rename spec IDs or add a mapping table bridging FR-dependency-* ↔ FR-070–085

backlog.title: 3 Portal Files Lack // Verifies: Comments
backlog.description: Unlinked implementations — these files implement FRs but carry no traceability comments, so coverage tracking is blind to them.
backlog.fix: Add // Verifies: FR-XXX comments to each file referencing the relevant spec IDs

backlog.title: Silent catch{} in cycleService.ts:103 (Architecture Violation)
backlog.description: JSON.parse failure swallowed with no logging, re-throw, or documented suppression. Architecture rule: every catch must re-throw, log with context, or explicitly document suppression.
backlog.fix: Add structured logging with context or re-throw; if suppression is intentional, add a comment explaining why

backlog.title: Body Parser DoS — Invalid Limit Disables Size Enforcement
backlog.fix: Update via express update; add explicit: app.use(express.json({ limit: '1mb' }))

backlog.title: Brace Expansion DoS
backlog.fix: Update all glob-related dependencies

backlog.title: QS Query String DoS (NULL Dereference)
backlog.fix: Update qs via express/body-parser update

backlog.title: PostCSS XSS via Unescaped </style>
backlog.fix: cd Source/Frontend && npm update postcss

backlog.title: Babel Core Arbitrary File Read via sourceMappingURL
backlog.fix: Update @babel/core via vite/typescript update

backlog.title: Vitest Transitive Vulnerability Chain
backlog.description: Vitest 2.0.5 chains to vulnerable Vite (DEP-003) and esbuild CSRF (DEP-016). Resolved by DEP-001 fix.
backlog.fix: Resolved by DEP-001 fix (vitest@^3.2.6)

backlog.title: ESBuild Dev Server CSRF
backlog.description: Dev server accepts cross-origin requests without origin validation → source code and env vars exfiltrated from dev environments.
backlog.fix: Update esbuild via vite update (DEP-003 fix resolves this transitively)

backlog.title: Express 2 Minor Versions Behind Patch Baseline
backlog.fix: Short-term: npm install express@4.22.2; Medium-term: plan Express 5.x migration

backlog.title: Pino 2 Major Versions Behind
backlog.fix: cd Source/Backend && npm install pino@^10.0.0

backlog.title: eslint-disable Without Rationale (2 occurrences)
backlog.description: react-hooks/exhaustive-deps suppressed with no comment explaining why it's safe. Makes future maintainers unable to evaluate risk.
backlog.fix: Add inline comment explaining why the suppression is safe, or fix the hook dependencies

backlog.title: DebugPortalPage.tsx Recently Modified — No Traceability
backlog.description: Modified within last 14 days; uses informal comment instead of // Verifies: FR-XXX. Not covered by enforcer gate.
backlog.fix: Add // Verifies: FR-XXX comment; update enforcer to scan this file path

backlog.title: UUID 5 Major Versions Behind (9.x vs 14.x current)
backlog.description: UUID is 5 major versions behind; the security CVE (DEP-004) requires 11.x+ minimum. DEP-004 fix partially covers this.
backlog.fix: Resolved by DEP-004 fix (uuid@^11.1.1); then plan migration to uuid@14.x

backlog.title: React Router 1 Major Version Behind (6.x vs 7.x current)
backlog.description: One major version behind; the security CVE (DEP-006) requires 6.30.4+ minimum. Long-term: plan React Router 7.x migration.
backlog.fix: Resolved by DEP-006 fix (react-router-dom@^6.30.4); then plan migration to react-router-dom@7.x

backlog.title: React 1 Major Version Behind (18.x vs 19.x current)
backlog.description: React 18.3.1 is one major version behind. No security CVE; monitor React 19 stabilization.
backlog.fix: Monitor React 19; plan migration after ecosystem stabilization

backlog.title: Express Query Parser — Monitor for Future DoS Risk
backlog.description: Current version (4.18.2) is not in vulnerable range (4.21.0-4.22.1). Monitor when upgrading.
backlog.fix: Monitor; address when upgrading to Express 5.x
